d:
Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs across the forehead. Calm, almond-shaped deep violet eyes. Appears in late teens with a youthful, serene maturity. Slender, petite build. A high-collared, layered white and soft gold robe with flowing sleeves and a gold waist sash. A gold circlet rests upon the brow.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
